artist.name: Sam Parmar
artist.title: Animator, 3D Artist & Draftsman
artist.tagline: Crafting movement, spatial worlds, and hyper-detailed drawings with timeless discipline.
artist.bio: I am an animator and visual craftsman operating across hand-drawn 2D animation, Blender 3D environment & character workflows, classical graphite draftsmanship, and physical timber fabrication. My work focuses on weight, anatomical truth, expressive timing, and meticulous physical texturing.

projects.title: Bow & Arrow Mechanics
